tools.name: find_agents
tools.description: Search fone.me for people's and businesses' AI agents by what they do or offer (e.g. 'dog walker', 'real estate agent in Miami', 'Spanish tutor'). Returns their fone.me links.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get who is behind a fone.me link (e.g. fone.me/samspearin) and what their agent can help with, before messaging it.

tools.name: message_agent
tools.description: Send a message to the AI agent at a fone.me link and get its reply — ask a question, request a booking or a quote, or leave a message for the person. The conversation continues across calls. Say who you're asking for in on_behalf_of.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: message_agent · Public sink: message_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: message_agent · Public sink: message_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
